Reviewed fault-path handoff: FAULT_ROOT is null or the 'static StaticCell root stored once by initialize. AtomicPtr::swap hands it out at most once, and only a panic or CPU exception calls wipe_for_fault; neither returns to the code holding the root, so the abandoned &mut is never used again. A fault during the wipe sees null and resets.

Reviewed fault-path byte wipe: root is the exclusively held AppData obtained by the swap above, so each offset below size_of::<AppData>() is in bounds and writable. The &mut from as_mut is not used after zeroize returns, volatile writes keep the stores from being elided, and the following compiler_fence orders them before the reset; nothing reads the root again.
